'''December 2001 Lexington tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Lexington, Kentucky on 15 December 2001. [[Shannon Huecker]] won it. It is known from Shannon Huecker's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3192">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-12-18-lexington-ky-chase-the-cans-12-15d3192/ lexington-ky-chase-the-cans-12-15], DeckTech (Shannon "Godsmacker" Huecker, 18 December 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-12-18-lexington-ky-chase-the-cans-12-15d3192/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 15 December 2001
* '''Site:''' Lexington, Kentucky
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Shannon Huecker]]
